messages.subject: abort trap: 6 errors
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I have been encountering problems trying to map reads with both Rsubread (v1.22.2) and subread (v1.5.0) to the new release of the dmel genome (dm6, using ref files from illumina iGenomes).

I successfully mapped these same reads with Rsubread (1.16.1) ~a year ago to dm5.

I have tried executing align and subjunc, but I still get the same abort trap: 6 error during loading of the index. I have tried mapping on three different computers running different OSs (Mac OS 10.9.5, Mac OS 10.10.5, and Windows 8 via cgywin) with Rsubread and subread, but the same error is produced every time. I have tried running with minimal options, fewer threads etc., etc. but nothing seems to work.

It always crashes (at different time points) during "loading the nth index...", so I have tried indexing multiple different ref genomes (from flybase and iGenomes), I have also tried on the unzipped fastq files. Every time producing the same error.

Here is an example...(note: I have tried building the index allowing the split option too)
